questions.question: A bus moving on a straight road at a speed of 10 km / h increases its speed to 70 km / h in 2 minutes. Find its average acceleration.
questions.solution:
__Concept:__

__
 
• Average acceleration: The change in velocity divided by the time taken to change the velocity is called average acceleration.
 
• Formula for average acceleration: Average acceleration (a) is given by the formula:
 
 
• a = (vf - vᵢ) / t
 
 
 
• Where:
 
 
• vf is the final velocity
 
• vᵢ is the initial velocity
 
• t is the time taken
 
 

**Calculations**__**:**

Given that,

__
 
• Initial velocity, vᵢ = 10 km/h
 
• Final velocity, vf = 70 km/h
 
• Time taken, t = 2 minutes = 2/60 hours = 1/30 hours

So we have a formula for average acceleration,

a = (vf - vᵢ) / t

Substituting the given values:

a = (70 - 10) / (1/30) = 60 × 30 = 1800 km/h²

To convert km/h² to km/min², we divide by 3600 (since 1 hour = 60 minutes and hence (60 minutes)² = 3600 minutes²):

a = 1800 / 3600 = 0.5 km/min²

**So the average acceleration of the bus is 0.5 km/min².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Acceleration is a vector quantity that has both magnitude and direction.
 
• Deceleration is negative acceleration where the speed of an object decreases over time.
 
• In SI units, acceleration is measured in meters per second squared (m/s²).

questions.question: A bullet of mass 10 g is ﬁred with a velocity of 20 m/s from a gun of mass 2 kg. Find the recoil velocity (in m/s) of the gun.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**0.1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The mass of the ejected body and the mass of the recoiling body are related to one another by the law of conservation of momentum which is obtained from **Newton’s laws of motion**.
 
• According to the **law of conservation of momentum**, for every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction. Recoiling velocity is an example of this law. From the law, it can be said that
 
 
• **m₁ v₁ = - m₂ v₂**
 
• m1 and v1 are the mass and velocity of the bullet
 
• m2 and v2 are the mass and velocity of the gun
 
 

 
• Here m₁= 10g = 0.01 kg, v₁ = 20 m/s and m₂ = 2 kg, 

⇒ m₁ v₁ = - m₂ v₂

⇒ 0.01 x 20 = - 2 x v₂

⇒ v₂ = 0.2 / 2 =** 0.1 m/s**

**Note: **Recoil velocity will always be **negative **as the gun will always move in the opposite direction of the fired bullet.

questions.question: For a body moving with uniform acceleration its final velocity equals ________.
questions.solution:
we know that,

Average velocity = (initial velocity + final velocity)/2

∴ Final velocity = 2 × average velocity – initial velocity

questions.question: During ________ motion of an object along a straight line, the velocity remains constant with time.
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**Uniform.**__

__**Explanation:**__

 
• Uniform motion is a motion in which a body moves in a specific direction at a constant speed.
 
• Uniform motion: when an object covers an equal distance in an equal time interval of time said to be in uniform motion. Here acceleration is zero.
 
• When a body moves in a perfect circle at a constant speed then it is called Uniform circular motion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9da31ac692e19833bbb185bde1d0751945bddb28f61777bda20ee2acf16f7418.png] 

 
• **Non-Uniform motion:** when an object covers unequal distances in the equal time interval of time said to be in non-uniform motion. Here acceleration is non-zero.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54b61f50b742c0c0242fbbf5e7060d435c2826d7c578c7b7f1137b2d52ce51b5.png]

questions.question: Identify the wrong pair with respect to different motions and their examples.

options.text: Periodic motion - Earth rotating on its axis
Rectilinear motion - A stone thrown up in the air at an angle
Rotational motion - Blades of a windmill
Oscillatory motion - A boat tossing up and down a river

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rectilinear motion - A stone thrown up in the air at an angle.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rectilinear motion**

 
 
• **A linear motion in which the direction of the velocity remains constant and the path is a straight line.**
 
• Following are the rectilinear motion examples:
 
 
• **The use of elevators in public places **
 
• **The motion of planes in the sky **
 
 
 
• There are three types of rectilinear motion:
 
 
• **Rectilinear movement with non-uniform acceleration**
 
• **Uniformly accelerated rectilinear motion**
 
• **Uniform rectilinear motion**
 
 
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Periodic motion**

 
 
• ​Periodic motion is a motion** repeated in equal intervals of time.**
 
• Examples are: 
 
 
• **A rocking chair**
 
• **A bouncing ball**
 
• **Earth rotating on its axis**
 
 
 
 
 
• **Rotational motion**
 
 
• ​Rotational motion can be defined as **the motion of an object around a circular path, in a fixed orbit.**
 
• Examples are:
 
 
• ​**A spinning wheel.**
 
• **Blades of a windmill**
 
 
 
 
 
• **Oscillatory motion**
 
 
• Oscillatory motion is defined as the **to and fro motion of an object from its mean position.**
 
• An example is: **Movement of a spring.**
